title: Non-blocking finding from PR #338's review (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups)
description: Tracked follow-up for a non-blocking finding raised in pr-reviewer's review of PR #338 (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups) -- doesn't block the accept (PR #338's own decisions entry already explicitly scoped this out, with reasonable rationale), but is worth fixing so it isn't lost once PR #338 merges and the review comment disappears from view.

checklist.step: `AddPositionDialog.tsx`'s `<Dialog open={open} onClose={onClose} fullWidth maxWidth="sm">` (line 153) still has the identical Escape-key/backdrop-click dismissal gap `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx` had before PR #338: only the dialog's own Cancel/Confirm buttons are guarded by `disabled={addPosition.isPending}` (lines 224/227), but MUI's `Dialog` fires `onClose` on Escape and backdrop click regardless of any button's disabled state, so a user can dismiss the dialog mid-`useAddPosition()` mutation. PR #338 fixed this exact pattern in `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx` via a `handleDialogClose` wrapper that no-ops while the mutation is pending (see that PR's diff and its own `decisions` entry, which explicitly deferred fixing `AddPositionDialog.tsx` in the same PR as a scope call, not an oversight). Apply the same guard here -- either a local `handleDialogClose` wrapper mirroring `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx`'s, or, now that this pattern exists in two dialogs, consider extracting a small shared helper/hook (e.g. `useGuardedDialogClose(onClose, isPending)`) if that's judged worth the abstraction at this point.

decisions.decision: Extracted a shared `useGuardedDialogClose(onClose, isPending)` hook (`frontend/src/features/portfolio/hooks/useGuardedDialogClose.ts`) rather than applying a second copy of `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx`'s inline `handleDialogClose` wrapper directly to `AddPositionDialog.tsx`. Both dialogs now call the shared hook; `IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx`'s own inline wrapper was replaced with a call to it too, so there is exactly one copy of the guard logic.
decisions.rationale: The parent task's (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups) own prior decisions entry explicitly deferred a shared abstraction as 'speculative generality until there's a third case' -- but that was written when only one confirmed instance (IbkrPreloadDialog) existed; this task is itself the second confirmed instance (AddPositionDialog), so extracting now eliminates real, already-existing duplication rather than anticipating a hypothetical future one. This mirrors the codebase's own precedent for the identical judgment call: `useResetOnSubjectChange` (frontend-trade-apgar-followups) was extracted from exactly two dialogs' (`TradeApgarDialog`/`FollowUpReviewDialog`) identical boilerplate, not held back for a third. Rejected leaving two independent inline copies: any future fix to this guard (e.g. also checking a `reason` argument) would then need to land in two places and could silently drift out of sync.
decisions.context: `ClosePositionDialog.tsx`, `FollowUpReviewDialog.tsx`, and `TradeApgarDialog.tsx` were found to have the same unguarded onClose-while-pending pattern during this task, but none of them are in this task's checklist scope -- left untouched and unfixed here; a future task should decide whether to extend `useGuardedDialogClose` to them too.

comments.summary: Refactor safety confirmed: diffed IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx's old inline handleDialogClose against the new useGuardedDialogClose(onClose, isPending) call -- identical logic (no-op while isPending, otherwise call onClose), argument order matches, and IbkrPreloadDialog.test.tsx (unmodified by this PR) still passes unchanged as part of the full 941/941 vitest run, confirming no behavior regression from the extraction.

Guard behavior verified for AddPositionDialog.tsx both by reading the code (Dialog's onClose wired to useGuardedDialogClose(onClose, addPosition.isPending), Cancel button unchanged) and with a live headless-Chromium Playwright walkthrough against the running dev stack: with the POST /api/portfolio/positions request held pending, both an Escape keypress and a forced backdrop click left the dialog open and onClose uncalled; once the mutation resolved (success screen shown), Escape then closed the dialog normally. No console errors or failed network requests observed during the walkthrough.

The shared-hook extraction decision (useGuardedDialogClose, rather than a second inline copy) is well-reasoned: correctly identifies this as the second confirmed instance of the pattern (not speculative), cites the useResetOnSubjectChange precedent (also extracted from exactly two call sites) accurately, and gives a concrete reason to prefer sharing (avoiding future drift between two copies of the same guard). No corrections needed.

Verified the task-worker's report that ClosePositionDialog.tsx, FollowUpReviewDialog.tsx, and TradeApgarDialog.tsx all still have the identical unguarded onClose-while-pending pattern (each dialog's Dialog onClose is wired directly to a caller-provided/local close handler with no isPending check, only the Cancel button is disabled). Since the shared useGuardedDialogClose hook now exists and applying it to these three is a small, well-scoped fix, filed as a new tracked follow-up (frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups-followups-followups) rather than leaving it only in this PR's description, per this codebase's every-non-blocking-finding-becomes-a-task convention.

useGuardedDialogClose.ts's placement under features/portfolio/hooks/ (a domain-agnostic hook -- takes only onClose/isPending, no portfolio-specific types) was considered against Frontend.md §3's common-vs-feature placement rule. No components/common/ (or equivalent common-hooks) location exists for non-domain hooks in this codebase; the closest precedent (useResetOnSubjectChange.ts's useOnValueChange, also domain-agnostic and already cross-imported by features/homework) already lives in exactly this location. This placement matches established, previously-accepted convention rather than introducing a new one, so not treated as a new finding.

Full independent verification: frontend vitest 941/941 passed, coverage 99.78%/99.13%/99.81%/99.83% (statements/branches/functions/lines); eslint and tsc -b both clean; profit-target wording guard clean; validate_tasks.py clean (328 files); e2e suite (make e2e) 26/26 specs passed. Backend unchanged by this PR's diff; backend pytest run showed 1443/1443 relevant passes plus one pre-existing, environment-only failure (test_ibkr_base_url_defaults_to_localhost_gateway, caused by this dev container's own gitignored backend/.env overriding FINTRADE_IBKR_BASE_URL to a real gateway hostname -- the same root cause already diagnosed and confirmed unrelated in PR #338's review), 100% coverage otherwise. code-review skill (self-run, single-pass) found zero findings.

review.notes: Accepted. The refactor of IbkrPreloadDialog.tsx onto the new shared useGuardedDialogClose hook is behavior-preserving (confirmed by diff + its own unmodified, still-passing test suite), AddPositionDialog.tsx's new guard is genuinely effective (confirmed by both code reading and a live browser walkthrough covering Escape, backdrop-click, and post-settle normal dismissal, with clean console/network), and the extraction decision is well-justified against real codebase precedent. The task's own checklist item is correctly marked done. One non-blocking finding (the three remaining unguarded dialogs, now a small fix given the shared hook) filed as docs/tasks/frontend-ibkr-portfolio-preload-followups-followups-followups.json so it isn't lost once this PR merges.
